summary.intent: Check the hosted CI status of all open PRs, diagnose why PR 261's CI was failing, and fix it.
summary.outcome: Traced PR 261's failure to the coverage job in .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml, changed the job to allow missing real-registry tools, reran CI, then committed the fix and updated the PR body. The transcript doesn't show whether the rerun passed.

repo: Hosted CI is defined in .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml and includes a coverage job.
The coverage job failed on PR 261 because real-registry tools were missing from the hosted CI environment.

code.finding: The coverage job needed to tolerate missing real-registry tools. The transcript gives no line numbers, so the location is unspecified.

workflow: Check the status of all open PRs first, then drill into the failing one's logs, find the failing line, and read the relevant workflow job before editing.
After changing a workflow, rerun CI, commit the fix, and update the PR body so the change is documented.

friction: Hosted CI failed on a tool-availability gap in the coverage job, a failure that only showed up after pushing to hosted CI.
Finding the failing line took several separate log and workflow inspection steps.
open_items: Confirm the rerun of hosted CI passes after the coverage job fix.
Consider whether allowing missing real-registry tools weakens coverage, and whether those tools should be installed in CI instead.
Check the other open PRs for similar CI failures.
